channel.title: Elia Liu — writing
channel.description: Long-form tutorials and build notes: streaming Python on Apache Beam, and other systems built by hand.

item.title: Watch: a polling transform for things that grow
item.description: Porting Apache Beam's Watch transform from Java to Python: polling Splittable DoFns, dedup by hash, termination conditions — and how to watch a directory for new files, forever. GSoC 2026, part 2.

item.title: Teaching Python pipelines to never stop
item.description: For a decade, Apache Beam's Python SDK had no unbounded sources. A from-zero tutorial on streaming, Splittable DoFns, and the UnboundedSource API built for GSoC 2026 — validated on four runners.
